## Workflows

::: {.workflow-tables}
### In-plane carbon exchange

Dispersion-corrected PM6 scans with the molecule held planar locate the in-plane exchange saddle and its IRC, and B3LYP/$6\text{-}31{+}\mathrm{G}(d)$ single points give density and ESP along the path.

| Status | Period | Workflow | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ![Caveats](../../../private/research-findings/projects/icons/warning.svg "Caveats"){.workflow-status} | 15–20 Oct 2026 | [Plane-constrained carbon exchange](2026-10-15_225959/) | Follows the in-plane exchange from both molecules through the planar saddle, with the ESP along the path. |

### Out-of-plane saddle searches

Twisted or out-of-plane starting geometries are refined with PM6-D3 and every coordinate free, and frequencies test whether each converged geometry is a first-order saddle.

| Status | Period | Workflow | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ![Caveats](../../../private/research-findings/projects/icons/warning.svg "Caveats"){.workflow-status} | 17 Oct 2026 | Out-of-plane central-bond torsion | Scans the central-bond dihedral for a twisted starting geometry and tests whether it refines to a stationary torsional saddle. |
| ![Caveats](../../../private/research-findings/projects/icons/warning.svg "Caveats"){.workflow-status} | 20 Oct 2026 | [Indigo displacement TS experiments](2026-10-20_144850/) | Refines two out-of-plane displaced geometries of indigo; neither converges to a first-order saddle. |
:::
